Long, waist-length silver white hair with straight bangs and a silky texture. Calm, wide light blue eyes. Appears in the early twenties with a serene, mature face. Slender, elegant build. A black high-collared dress with a flared skirt and white lace detailing. Features a black visor covering the upper half of the face and black thigh-high boots.
BODY COLOR: pale ivory
